PositionHistory.Description: Deloitte Consulting Experience - 68 Months 1. Industry: Public Sector/Health Insurance Role/Duration: Senior Developer, Solution Architect/ 3 months. Working on the assessment and creating a solution for one of the US State major HIX implementation. Key Responsibilities: Worked on conducting technical session with client and vender Verification of existing issues and prepare upcoming technical recommendations Estimation, Technical Design and Implementation Technology/Frameworks: IBM Websphere 7, ILOG JRules (ODM), Spring, Hibernate, DB2, SVN, Maven, Java, Struts, WESB, Data Power, Crystal Report, Adobe Life Cycle, WebCenter (ADF) 2. Industry: Public Sector/Insurance Role/Duration: Senior Developer, Solution Architect / 12 months. In order to transform and modernize the state services delivered to customers in a holistic and collaborative manner, one of the US State has determined it necessary to build and deploy a Common Access Front End system for ES, CS and CW programs. This comprises of the end user facing customer portal, provider portal and internal worker portals. Key Responsibilities: Worked closely with Functional team for Functional Design review and Technical Design. Participated in the JAD sessions with the Client. Worked on overall Project Planning, Tracking and Effort Estimation Led the team for worker portal development - ES, CS, CW and Providers modules. Worked on Framework optimization, design and architecture of overall application. Ramped up the team on Functional and technical aspects for the project Technology/Frameworks: IBM Websphere 7, ILog Jrules (ODM), Corticon, Adobe Flex, Spring, Hibernate, DB2, ClearCase, Maven, Data Migrator Tools and HATS (For client legacy system integration). 3. Industry: Financial Services (Mortgage Fee Processing) Role/Duration: Senior Developer, Solution Architect / 16 months In light of the FTC settlement and increased scrutiny by federal regulators like OCC, banks are under increased pressure to ensure that fees charged to borrowers are in compliance with state and federal laws, investor guidelines, local bankruptcy court rulings, fair market value of services and individual bank polices. Banks now need to find a balance between how much to charge to borrowers, how much to recover from investors and how much to write-off as losses. Banks now also face additional scrutiny from investors who are concerned that servicers will now act with extra caution and leave money on the table. Finally, ensuring compliance will require investments in technology infrastructure to achieve regulatory compliance Key Responsibilities: Lead the team on Java and Rule Engine (ILog-JRules) work. Work on design and architecture of overall application. Analysis and gathering of business requirements. Business rules design and development (Using - ILOG). Integration of Business Rules with Java and client application. Design and implement Interfaces to verify the architecture and systems' integration Technology/Frameworks: IBM Websphere application server 7, BREDGES, IBM ILOG Jrules BRMS 7, Jasper Report, Oracle 10g, Hudson, Blade Logic, Quality Center, SVN, EJB, IBM MQ. 4. Industry: Public Sector (Child Welfare) Role/Duration: Senior Developer, Solution Architect / 18 months HHS NextGen is Health and Human Services (HHS) Solution Suite which is being built in incremental manner. This solution is being used to demonstrate Deloitte's Child Welfare capabilities and will also provide comprehensive foundation to jumpstart new Child Welfare engagements. This solution was focused towards building cutting edge solutions using Rule Engine (ILOG - BRMS), Adobe Flex, Adobe LiveCycle Enterprise Suite, Enterprise Service Bus (IBM ESB) and Process Servers. Key Responsibilities: Led the team on Research oriented works (Rules Engine- ILOG/Corticon, Flex, Hibernate, Spring, BRIDGES, Search Engine- Netrics, Crystal Reports, etc.) Business rules design and development (Using - ILOG, CORTICON). Integration of Business Rules with ESB and Web Application. Work on application architecture for Flex, J2EE layer(Business Layer) and Integration Layer (Rule Engine-ILOG/ Search Engine-Netrics, ESB) Research and implementation of Rules Engines, Flex and Search Engines work. Design and implement Interfaces to verify the architecture and systems' integration Technology/Frameworks: IBM Websphere application server 6/7, IBM Websphere Process Server 7, IBM Websphere Enterprise Service Bus 7, Adobe Flex, IBM ILOG BRMS, Netrics Search Engine, LCDS, BlazeDS, Hibernate, Spring, Crystal Reports. 5. Industry: Public Sector Role/Duration: Developer / 20 months In the United States of America, there is a federal mandate for all the states to have a software system in place conforming to the SACWIS standard - to manage and track child welfare activities including adoption, placement, court processing and other required features. This project is all about implementing SACWIS solution for one of the US State. The project follows the CMMi Level 5 methodology for the software engineering processes. Key Responsibilities: Use Case analysis and Requirements understanding. Design analysis, implementation and unit testing. Release/Build Management Report integration and Management Technology/Frameworks: Java-J2EE, JBOSS-4.2, Oracle 10g, Struts, EJB (Session, Entity Bean), Optimal J, CVS.

Industry: Technology, Media & Telecommunications Role/Duration: Developer, Release-Configuration Management / 24 months This is web portal development for the leading Telecom/Network/kable Tv distribution platform in Denmark. Client Solutions services over 15 million homes passed in more than 20 cable markets throughout the US. This web portal is accessed from 32 different divisions; each has some distinguish features and different database. This application utilizes most of J2EE concepts.
